preconditions.expression: stdin.count('\n') == T + 1 and T == int(stdin.split('\n')[0]) and 1 <= T <= 20
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 20), followed by exactly T lines, each containing an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 20000).

preconditions.expression: all(N.isdigit() and 1 <= int(N) <= 20000 for N in stdin.split('\n')[1:T+1])
preconditions.description: Each of the T lines after the first is a string N representing an integer between 1 and 20000 (inclusive), with no leading zeros.

postconditions.expression:
stdout.count('
') == T and all((stdout.split('
')[i] == 'wins') == (N == N[::-1]) for i, N in enumerate(stdin.split('
')[1:T+1]))
postconditions.description: For each integer N in the input (lines 2 to T+1), the corresponding line in stdout is 'wins' if and only if N is a palindrome (i.e., N reads the same forwards and backwards).
